rubrics.justification: The response repeatedly misidentifies the image as a single cell or degenerating cell, fabricates nucleus/ICM/TE details not clearly visible, and does not provide a reliable morphology assessment consistent with the image.
It integrates age, BMI, FSH, uterine factor, endometrial thickness, sperm data, prior cycle history, and smoking with embryo quality reasonably well, though some points are oversimplified.
The reasoning is highly repetitive and internally contradictory, oscillating between calling the image degenerating and consistent with 4AA, which undermines the logic of the conclusions.

General recommendations such as proceeding with transfer, smoking cessation, and uterine cavity evaluation are broadly guideline-consistent, but the morphology interpretation and implantation-rate framing are not well grounded.
It offers some practical next steps (transfer, smoking cessation, uterine workup, consider PGT-A), but recommendations are generic and lack case-specific nuance or transfer-planning detail.
